name: Arjuna Visada Yoga
summary: Arjuna requests Krishna to move his chariot between the two armies. His mind is overwhelmed with grief and he decides not to fight.

name: Sankhya Yoga
summary: Krishna teaches Arjuna about the immortal nature of the soul and introduces the path of self-realization through actions without attachment.

name: Karma Yoga
summary: Krishna explains the performance of duties in modern life and how taking action without expecting rewards purifies the mind.

name: Jnana Karma Sanyasa Yoga
summary: Krishna reveals his divine appearances and teaches that true knowledge brings immense peace and removes ignorance.

name: Karma Sanyasa Yoga
summary: Krishna compares the path of knowledge and the path of action, emphasizing that both lead to the same spiritual goal.

name: Dhyana Yoga
summary: Krishna details the practice of meditation, control of the restless mind, and the ultimate achievement of deep spiritual union.

name: Jnana Vijnana Yoga
name_meaning: The Yoga of Knowledge and Wisdom
summary: Krishna describes his absolute reality, the material and spiritual energies, and how living beings are part of his divine nature.

name: Aksara Brahma Yoga
summary: Krishna explains the cosmos, the journey of the soul after death, and the method of remembering the Supreme at the time of leaving the body.

name: Raja Vidya Raja Guhya Yoga
name_meaning: The Yoga of the Sovereign Science
summary: Krishna reveals the sovereign, most profound and secret knowledge about the universe and how true devotion brings ultimate salvation.

name: Vibhuti Yoga
summary: Krishna describes his endless divine manifestations, showing how he is the essence of all beautiful, glorious, and powerful things.

name: Visvarupa Darsana Yoga
name_meaning: The Yoga of the Vision of the Universal Form
summary: Krishna grants Arjuna divine vision and reveals his spectacular, terrifying, and awe-inspiring universal form.

name: Bhakti Yoga
summary: Krishna explains the path of loving devotion, the qualities of a true devotee, and how it is the highest and easiest path to God.

name: Ksetra Ksetrajna Vibhaga Yoga
name_meaning: The Yoga of the Field and its Knower
summary: Krishna distinguishes between the physical body (the field) and the soul (the knower), revealing the nature of true knowledge.

name: Gunatraya Vibhaga Yoga
name_meaning: The Yoga of the Three Modes of Material Nature
summary: Krishna explains the three qualities of nature (goodness, passion, and ignorance) and how to transcend them.

name: Purusottama Yoga
name_meaning: The Yoga of the Supreme Divine Personality
summary: Krishna uses the analogy of an upside-down banyan tree to explain the material world and reveals his identity as the Supreme Being.

name: Daivasura Sampad Vibhaga Yoga
name_meaning: The Yoga of Divine and Demoniac Natures
summary: Krishna details the divine qualities that lead to liberation and the demoniac qualities that bind the soul to suffering.

name: Sraddhatraya Vibhaga Yoga
name_meaning: The Yoga of the Threefold Faith
summary: Krishna categorizes faith, food, sacrifices, austerities, and charity into the three modes of material nature.

name: Moksa Sanyasa Yoga
name_meaning: The Yoga of Liberation by Renunciation
summary: Krishna summarizes all previous teachings, explaining the final path of liberation through surrender and renunciation of the fruits of action.
